hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition in Andalusia
hotspots.blurb: The conservative People's Party (PP) and far-right Vox have reached a coalition agreement to govern Andalusia, marking the first time Vox will enter a regional government since the Franco era. The deal includes Vox gaining a vice-presidency and key ministries, while PP's Juanma Moreno is set to be re-elected as president.
hotspots.affect: This development commands disproportionate attention due to its symbolic and political significance, representing a major shift in Spain's political landscape and the normalization of far-right participation in government.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei's Central Bank reform
hotspots.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei is pushing for a significant reform of the Central Bank's Organic Charter, aiming to end inflation by removing conflicting monetary policy goals. The proposal has sparked intense debate, with former Central Bank presidents criticizing it as risky and linked to IMF demands.
hotspots.affect: This issue commands high affective investment due to its economic stakes, polarized opinions, and the moral framing of Milei's libertarian policies as either revolutionary or reckless.

hotspots.title: AfD ban debate intensifies
hotspots.blurb: The debate over banning Germany's far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has gained momentum, with calls for a swift ban procedure in the Bundesrat. The AfD's rising poll numbers and its classification as a suspected extremist threat by domestic intelligence have fueled this controversy.
hotspots.affect: This issue commands high affective investment due to its existential implications for German democracy, the moral panic over far-right extremism, and the polarized contention between those advocating for a ban and those defending democratic freedoms.
